accepted.name: publications_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "application_number" AS application_number,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  "kind_code" AS kind_code,
  "application_kind" AS application_kind,
  "application_number_formatted" AS application_number_formatted,
  "pct_number" AS pct_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date,
  "filing_date" AS filing_date,
  "grant_date" AS grant_date,
  "priority_date" AS priority_date,
  "entity_status" AS entity_status,
  "art_unit" AS art_unit,
  "title_localized" AS title_localized,
  "abstract_localized" AS abstract_localized,
  "claims_localized" AS claims_localized,
  "description_localized" AS description_localized,
  "inventor" AS inventor,
  "inventor_harmonized" AS inventor_harmonized,
  "assignee" AS assignee,
  "assignee_harmonized" AS assignee_harmonized,
  "ipc" AS ipc,
  "cpc" AS cpc,
  "publication_number" || '::pub' AS _row_id_for_joining
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
accepted.description: Normalized projection of PUBLICATIONS that exposes core identifying, temporal and descriptive fields (one row per publication_number). Use this as the canonical publication row for filtering, joining, and downstream normalization. | Use for: select publications by date / country / assignee; join publications to disclosures by family_id; normalize variant fields (cpc, inventor, assignee) starting from canonical publication rows

accepted.name: disclosures_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "record_id" AS record_id,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "disclosure_event" AS disclosure_event,
  "sso" AS sso,
  "patent_owner_harmonized" AS patent_owner_harmonized,
  "patent_owner_unharmonized" AS patent_owner_unharmonized,
  "date" AS date,
  "standard" AS standard,
  "committee_project" AS committee_project,
  "tc_name" AS tc_name,
  "sc_name" AS sc_name,
  "wg_name" AS wg_name,
  "licensing_commitment" AS licensing_commitment,
  "copyright" AS copyright,
  "blanket_type" AS blanket_type,
  "blanket_scope" AS blanket_scope,
  "third_party" AS third_party,
  "reciprocity" AS reciprocity,
  "serial_cleaned" AS serial_cleaned,
  "pub_cleaned" AS pub_cleaned
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.DISCLOSURES_13
grain: record_id (one row per disclosure event record)
accepted.description: Canonical projection of disclosure events exposing identifiers, family linkage, event type, dates and owner fields (one row per record_id). Useful for filtering disclosure cohorts and joining to publications by family_id. | Use for: count disclosures by family / owner / standard; find disclosures for publications by joining on family_id; filter disclosures by committee/project or licensing attributes

accepted.name: publication_cpc_exploded
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  c.value::string AS cpc_symbol,
  c.value AS cpc_variant
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "cpc") AS c
grain: publication_number, cpc_symbol (one row per publication per CPC element)
accepted.description: Unnests the VARIANT cpc array/object from PUBLICATIONS into one row per publication_number per cpc_symbol. Preserves the original publication keys and exposes the raw symbol string and original variant element. Useful for joining to CPC_DEFINITION or aggregating by cpc code. | Use for: join publications to CPC_DEFINITION by symbol; count publications per CPC symbol or hierarchy; filter publications that include a particular CPC code (apply filter on cpc_symbol)

accepted.name: latest_publication_per_family
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY family_id ORDER BY publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, publication_number) AS publication_rank,
  CASE WHEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY family_id ORDER BY publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, publication_number) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_latest_for_family
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
grain: publication_number (ranked within family_id; one row per publication with rank)
accepted.description: Identifies the most recent publication row per family_id based on publication_date. Exposes a rank and the chosen latest flag. Useful for family-level deduplication and selecting canonical publications per family. | Use for: select latest publication per family (filter where publication_rank = 1); compare attributes across publications within the same family

accepted.name: cpc_definition_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "symbol" AS symbol,
  "titleFull" AS title_full,
  "level" AS level,
  "status" AS status,
  "definition" AS definition_variant,
  "parents" AS parents_variant,
  "children" AS children_variant,
  "dateRevised" AS date_revised
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.CPC_DEFINITION
grain: symbol (one row per CPC symbol/definition entry)
accepted.description: Projection of CPC_DEFINITION exposing symbol, title, level, status and variant fields. Use as the canonical CPC definition rows for joining after normalizing publication CPC codes. | Use for: lookup CPC title or level for a given cpc symbol; join CPC metadata to exploded publication CPCs
